name: Cities of Sigmar - Allies of the Free Cities

abilities.name: Forces of Order
abilities.effect: While 3 friendly Allies of the Free Cities units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the Aelf keyword, 1 of those units has the Duardin keyword, and 1 of those units has the Sigmarite keyword: • Those units have Ward (5+) against shooting attacks. • Add 3 to those units' control scores. • Add 1 to wound rolls for those units' combat attacks.

abilities.name: Form Up, Allies!
abilities.timing: Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Allies of the Free Cities unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly Allies of the Free Cities units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. The unit using this ability and the targets: • cannot be under orders • must each be a different unit type.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders. Designer's Note: *'Unit type' refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. 'Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal' or 'Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard'.*

powers.name: These Realms Are Ours
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Allies of the Free Cities Wizard to cast this spell, pick an objective within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly Allies of the Free Cities units have Charge (+1 Damage) for attacks that target enemy units that are contesting the target objective.

powers.name: Divine Mandate
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Allies of the Free Cities Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Allies of the Free Cities unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

summon.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

summon.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

weapons.name: Burning Breath
weapons.ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Signet of the City
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly Allies of the Free Cities unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • The targets are under orders. • The targets have Ward (6+). • The targets have a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Respected Commander
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a visible Allies of the Free Cities unit wholly within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you cn use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Hauled to War
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Normal Move' ability for a Cities of Sigmar Infantry unit within 3" of this terrain feature
abilities.effect: After the 'Normal Move' ability has been resolved, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of the unit that used that ability and within 6" of this terrain feature. Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Fury of the Faithful
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature is in combat, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly Cities of Sigmar Infantry and Cavalry units have Crit (Auto-wound) for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Runic Crucible
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Sigmarite unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, the target's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Crucible of Rage
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do: • Apply the effect below. • If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly Cities of Sigmar units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Deathly Candlelight
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ominous Presence
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the 'Deathly Candlelight' ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

abilities.name: Incandescent Incineration
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target was not incandescent when they were picked to be the target of this spell: • Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. • The target is incandescent for the rest of the battle. If the target was incandescent when they were picked to be the target of this spell: • Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). • The target is no longer incandescent.

abilities.name: The Flames of Aqshy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the 'Incandescent Incineration' ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

abilities.name: Hidden Murderer
abilities.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Infantry unit that has 5 or more models and there are no enemy units within this unit's combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units.

abilities.name: In for the Kill
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Protective Focus
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: Pick a Spell ability that this unit can use. For the rest of the battle, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit if it miscasts that spell.

abilities.name: Storm of Shemtek
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Portents of Battle
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar Human unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

weapons.name: Griffon's Razor Claws and Twin Beaks

abilities.name: Ghurish Ferocity
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Griffon's Razor Claws and Twin Beaks for attacks that target enemy Monsters for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Griffon's Razor Claws and Twin Beaks is 4.

abilities.name: Searing Beam of Light
abilities.effect: Each time this unit attacks with its Searing Beam of Light, pick a point on the battlefield within range to be the target. If the attack scores a hit, draw a straight line between that point and the closest point on this unit's base. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.

abilities.name: Aura of Protection
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has Ward (6+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: 'At Them, You Curs!'
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Black Ark Corsairs unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points: • The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3. • It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Full Power!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of heat tokens equal to the number beside it. **1 *Launch Countermeasures!*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly Sigmarite units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are under orders. 2 *Full Throttle*: For the rest of the turn, this unit's Move characteristic is 10". 3 *Calculate Firing Solution!*: For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a Shoot ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit's Godbreaker Cannon. 6 *Get Us Out of Here!*:** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use Shoot abilities even if it used a Retreat ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.effect: Immediately after resolving this unit's 'Full Power!' ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of heat tokens this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit's heat tokens.

abilities.name: Special Ammunition
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit.
abilities.effect: If this unit is under orders, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects. ***Nullshot*: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made with this unit's Godbreaker Cannon this phase. *Heavy Shot*: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's Godbreaker Cannon this phase. *Grapeshot*: After that Shoot ability has been resolve, if all of the attacks made with this unit's Godbreaker Cannon** targeted the same enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within that enemy unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Direct the Gyrocorps

abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly Gyrocopter or Gyrobomber units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn: • Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks. • Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic.

abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points: • The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3. • It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: All Aboard!
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly Sigmarite Infantry Hero and up to 1 friendly non-Hero Sigmarite Infantry unit that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit's passengers. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Sally Forth
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has not used a Run ability this turn, pick this unit's passengers to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within 1/2" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not under orders, this unit and the targets are under orders for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Black Dragon's Claws is 4.

abilities.name: Indiscriminate Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Under the Shadow of Black Wings
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly Cities of Sigmar Aelf Cavalry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: 'For Sigmar, For Glory!'
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit.
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly non-Hero Sigmarite Cavalry unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit, is not in combat and has not used a Run ability this turn to be the target. After the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit is in combat, the target can immediately use the 'Charge' ability as if it were your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Run Down the Foe
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 non-Hero Sigmarite Cavalry units that charged this turn and are wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target: • Make a pile-in move. • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Front-line Commander
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: If this unit is under orders, pick a friendly Sigmarite Infantry or Monster unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit or has this unit's Relic Envoy next to it and that has not used a Fight ability this turn to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn

abilities.name: Attendant Relic Envoy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: This unit's Relic Envoy is a token. Pick a visible friendly Sigmarite unit wholly within 18" of this unit and not under orders to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place this unit's Relic Envoy next to the target. While this unit is under orders and on the battlefield and this unit's Relic Envoy is next to the target, the target is under orders.

weapons.name: Griffon's Razor Claws and Deadly Beak

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Griffon's Razor Claws and Deadly Beak  is 4.

abilities.name: Tactical Acumen
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly Cities of Sigmar Human unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Piercing Bloodroar
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Coordinate Attacks
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly Sigmarite units that are under orders that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Consecrate the Land
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective you control that this unit is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: If there are no enemy units contesting the target objective, it is considered by you to be consecrated. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target objective is considered by you to be consecrated. While they are wholly within 6" of a consecrated objective and under orders: • Friendly non-War Machine Sigmarite units have Ward (5+). • Friendly Sigmarite War Machines have Ward (6+). If your opponent gains control of a consecrated objective, it is no longer consecrated.

abilities.name: Runes of Spellbreaking
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Forgefire
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Duardin unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Cruel Sacrifice
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar Aelf unit wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn. Then, roll a dice. On a 4+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Word of Pain
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Black Dragon's Claws is 4.

abilities.name: Command Underlings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Cities of Sigmar Aelf Infantry units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.
abilities.effect: Add 3" to the Move characteristic of each target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Feed on Life Force
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, place a dark sorcery token next to this unit for the rest of the battle, to a maximum of 3 tokens.

abilities.name: Dark Sorcery
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each dark sorcery token it has.

abilities.name: Division Commander
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly Steam Tank units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by this unit and by each target.

abilities.name: More Pressure!
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn: *Power the Wheels:* This unit can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn. *Power the Guns:* Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Steam Gun.

abilities.name: Fearless Leader
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-Hero Cities of Sigmar Duardin unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Ancestral Grudgebearer
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in your opponent's army to bear a grudge against. You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Cities of Sigmar Duardin units that target that unit.

abilities.name: Swift Shots
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can immediately use the 'Shoot' ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must be in combat with this unit and have charged this phase.

abilities.name: Steel and Sorcery
abilities.effect: While any friendly Cities of Sigmar Aelf Infantry Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Merciless Conquerors
abilities.declare: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Storm of Shemtek
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Portents of Battle
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar Human unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Sow Havoc
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+: • Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. • This unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Storm of Iron-tipped Bolts
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a Move ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Master‑crafted Repeater Crossbows for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scythed Runners
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Bestial Instincts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Drakespawn's Ferocious Jaws while it is in combat with any enemy units that had any damage points allocated to them this phase or that had any models slain this phase.

abilities.name: Coven Guard
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Severing Strike
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, this unit's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

abilities.name: Glorious Martyrs
abilities.effect: While a friendly Sigmarite Priest is wholly within this unit's combat range, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Storm of Steel
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat and has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that it is in combat with and up to 1 friendly Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: If this unit is under orders, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. This unit and the friendly target can use the 'Charge' ability even if it is not your charge phase and even if those units are in combat. Both friendly units must end that move in combat with the enemy target.

abilities.name: The Red Work
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat and has not charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal or Freeguild Marshal on Griffon within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if there are fewer models in this unit than the total number of enemy models in units that are in combat with this unit. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, the targets count as having charged.

abilities.name: Freeguild Adjutants
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sigmarite unit wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. Add 5 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Blackpowder Squire
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit and this unit is in combat
abilities.effect: This unit's Blackpowder Squire is a token. Remove this unit's Blackpowder Squire from the battlefield, then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fortified Position
abilities.effect: While this unit is under orders: • This unit's ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat. • Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Not One Step Back
abilities.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Break Them Upon the Walls
abilities.effect: While this unit is under orders, the melee weapons of other visible friendly Sigmarite units, excluding Freeguild Gallants units, have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Cinders and Ashes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit contains a Cindergout, pick a terrain feature or objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units contesting that terrain feature or objective to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Steel of Helm and Heart
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has 5 or more models, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this unit is under orders, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is a Monster. On a 4+, apply the effect below. For the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a Fight ability: • This unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in move made by the target. • All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit's combat range must target this unit.

abilities.name: Aggressive Defenders
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 other visible friendly Sigmarite units in combat with any enemy units that are in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can use Shoot and/or Charge abilitie even if it used a Retreat ability this turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by Retreat abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Open the Gates!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-War Machine Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Grudgebuster Bombs
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit used a Move ability this phase, pick an enemy unit that does not have Fly and that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects: *Tactical Bombing:* Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. *Drop It All!:* Make 2 rolls of D3. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) within the target's combat range that does not have Fly. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Once the 'Drop It All!' effect of this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Guild Bombs
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit used a Move ability this phase, pick an enemy unit that does not have Fly and that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Oathsworn
abilities.effect: While any friendly Warden Kings are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly Warden Kings have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Gromril Shieldwall
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a Move ability this turn and was not set up this turn, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: Cinderblast Bomb
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Relentless Bombardment
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is under orders. On a 3+, subtract 2 from charge rolls and run rolls for the target unit until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Goaded and Whipped
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Abyssal Howl
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: `I Thought Duardin Were Made of Sterner Stuff!`
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly Cities of Sigmar Duardin unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a Longbeards unit.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Searing Beam of Light
abilities.effect: Each time this unit attacks with its Searing Beam of Light, pick a point on the battlefield within range to be the target. If the attack scores a hit, draw a straight line between that point and the closest point on this unit's base. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.

abilities.name: Aura of Protection
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has Ward (6+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: Lay the Beast Low
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target enemy Monsters.

abilities.name: More Pressure!
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn: *Power the Wheels:* This unit can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn. *Power the Guns:* Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Steam Gun.

abilities.name: Impossible To Destroy
abilities.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll 6 dice. Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled for each destroyed head token this unit has. If any of the rolls are a 5+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) this unit for each 5+. Finally, give this unit 1 destroyed head token.

abilities.name: Six-headed Strike
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Expert Pathfinders
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to two friendly non-Monster non-War Machine Sigmarite units if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve scouting ahead. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Prepared Arrival
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is scouting ahead.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit scouting ahead wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
